user_sees: Title 'Visits', 'Who trained, and when'
Tabs with 'Losing the habit' and its count
'Check someone in' with 'Day' and the box 'Type a name or the last 4 digits of a mobile'
must_not: Members of another branch in the list
A future day offered

steps.action: Type the last 4 digits of a member's mobile and tap the member
user_sees: Toast '<name> checked in.'
The member under 'Check-ins today' with the time
The count tiles go up by one
must_not: A second visit for the same member and day from a double tap
A check-in for a member whose plan ended shown with no warning
The visit dated on another day

steps.action: Tap the main button of step 2 of "Visits" twice, fast.
user_sees: One result; the button shows it is busy
must_not: Two rows of Gym list record, two charges, two messages sent, or two screens opened

note: Two desks check the same member in
